source.context:
[translated-scripture: JOB 19:13]
“He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

[translated-scripture: JOB 19:14]
My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

[translated-scripture: JOB 19:15]
Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
source.title: JOB 19:14

source.text: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
source.context:
[translated-scripture: 2TI 2:15]
Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

[translated-scripture: 2TI 2:16]
But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

[translated-scripture: 2TI 2:17]
and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
source.title: 2TI 2:16

source.text: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
source.context:
[translated-scripture: ROM 15:22]
Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

[translated-scripture: ROM 15:23]
but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

[translated-scripture: ROM 15:24]
whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
source.title: ROM 15:23

source.text: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
source.context:
[translated-scripture: LEV 26:6]
“‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

[translated-scripture: LEV 26:7]
You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

[translated-scripture: LEV 26:8]
Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
source.title: LEV 26:7

source.text: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.
source.context:
[translated-scripture: LEV 26:16]
I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

[translated-scripture: LEV 26:17]
I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

[translated-scripture: LEV 26:18]
“‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
source.title: LEV 26:17

source.text: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God.
source.context:
[translated-scripture: LEV 26:43]
The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

[translated-scripture: LEV 26:44]
Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God.

[translated-scripture: LEV 26:45]
But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am Yahweh.’”
source.title: LEV 26:44

source.text: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.
source.context:
[translated-scripture: JDG 5:30]
‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’

[translated-scripture: JDG 5:31]
“So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.
source.title: JDG 5:31

source.text: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
source.context:
[translated-scripture: EXO 32:30]
On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

[translated-scripture: EXO 32:31]
Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

[translated-scripture: EXO 32:32]
Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”
source.title: EXO 32:31

source.text: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
source.context:
[translated-scripture: PSA 25:18]
Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

[translated-scripture: PSA 25:19]
Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

[translated-scripture: PSA 25:20]
Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
source.title: PSA 25:19

source.text: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
source.context:
[translated-scripture: PSA 18:1]
For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

[translated-scripture: PSA 18:2]
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
source.title: PSA 18:1

source.text: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.
source.context:
[translated-scripture: EXO 23:4]
“If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

[translated-scripture: EXO 23:5]
If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

[translated-scripture: EXO 23:6]
“You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
source.title: EXO 23:5

source.text: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
source.context:
[translated-scripture: LUK 6:26]
Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

[translated-scripture: LUK 6:27]
“But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

[translated-scripture: LUK 6:28]
bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
source.title: LUK 6:27

source.text: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
source.context:
[translated-scripture: MAT 5:43]
“You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

[translated-scripture: MAT 5:44]
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

[translated-scripture: MAT 5:45]
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
source.title: MAT 5:44
